next_question.rationale: Reason clusters show large ‘abandoned by system’ (54,015) and patient-selection abandons (4,134) that read like routing/availability failures. I expect certain consultation triggers (e.g. instant/walk-in or marketplace matching triggers) to have materially lower created→confirmed conversion than others (e.g. request-with-scheduled-doctor or referral flows). If consultation_trigger explains much of the 87,511 created→confirmed loss, the mechanism is doctor-availability/routing rather than payments or UI bugs — that points to capacity or matching fixes. Also request hour_of_day as a second cut to test whether low conversion concentrates in specific hours (off-hours or peak mismatch), which would further support an availability window / scheduling mismatch explanation.
